sections.title: 5. Maintenance buffs
sections.html:
These two are the only things to maintain. Strength in Adversity (15 sec parry from Avenger's Shield) stays up on its own if you just run the rotation, so a bar is optional.

Make icons glow instead of bars (Bar Glows): Grand Crusader → Avenger's Shield · Vanguard → Shield of the Righteous · Divine Purpose → Shield of the Righteous · Shining Light → Word of Glory (when health is low).

  1. ESC → Options → Gameplay Enhancements → Advanced Cooldown Settings → Buffs tab, move the buffs above into the Tracked Bars slot. In the Tracked Buffs slot the bar won't show a timer.
  2. /eui → Cooldown Manager → Tracking Bars, add them as bars, then use Unlock Mode to attach them next to the center icon row.

sections.title: 5. Maintenance buffs
sections.html:
Playing Divine Guidance: stacks are not your Holy Power count but the number of Holy Power abilities like SotR you've used. Using SotR as normal builds them automatically, so don't sit on Holy Power waiting. When it's time to recast Consecration, just drop it even at 3-4 stacks; don't clip the ground effect to reach 5 stacks.

Instead of bars, watch these: Holy Bulwark isn't a maintenance buff; use it right before big tank busters and big pulls, and keep one charge in reserve but don't sit at 2 full charges. Rite of Sanctification is a 1-hour weapon enchant, so just check it's on before the M+ key starts (EllesmereUI AuraBuff Reminders).

  1. ESC → Options → Gameplay Enhancements → Advanced Cooldown Settings → Buffs tab, move the buffs above into the Tracked Bars slot. In the Tracked Buffs slot the bar won't show a timer.
  2. /eui → Cooldown Manager → Tracking Bars, add them as bars, then use Unlock Mode to attach them next to the center icon row.
  3. For the Divine Guidance bar, enable Stack Based Bar with max 5, and use + Add Threshold so it turns gold at 5 stacks. Gold is your signal to drop Consecration. Put it right next to the Consecration bar.
